result.brief: 提出仿真框架：用对抗运动先验训练的人类响应策略生成真实受助者动作，配合自适应脚本控制器大规模采集演示，训练3D扩散策略实现全身辅助机器人策略并初步sim-to-real迁移。
result.reason: Simulation-based learning of whole-body assistive robot policies with a human motion policy and 3D diffusion policies; main contribution is robot policy/control, matching the secondary applications direction.
